title: Taiwan · Taroko Gorge and East Coast
slogan: A 131 km loop out of Taroko Gorge
story: Marble canyon, high road and weather risk. It goes by way of Tianxiang and Qixingtan beach. Hehuanshan high road is the high point. It tops out at about 3,300 m. It is a high-mountain day.

title: Taipei · Yangmingshan and North Coast
slogan: A 69 km loop out of Yangmingshan
story: Volcanic hills and sea air close to the city. 69 km round from Taipei - plan on about 1 h 20 of riding. The stops in between: Jinshan coast, Yehliu geopark and Keelung. Yangmingshan is the high point. It is a high-mountain day.
